data.name: Matthia
data.gender_notes: Matthia is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Mattiyahu and the Greek name Matthias, Matthia means 'gift of God'. In the New Testament, Matthias is one of the twelve apostles chosen by Jesus to spread the gospel. The name Matthia carries the meaning “Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Matthia usually hope their child will grow to embody gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing divine gifts and blessings.
data.etymology: Matthia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gift of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Matthia total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_latin.name: Matthia
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Matthiae, auctoris Evangelii secundum Matthaeum.
in_latin.long_meaning: Matthia, nomen Hebraicum, significat 'donum Dei'. Matthias erat unus ex discipulis Jesu, qui succedebat Iudae, qui seipsum tradidit ut per eum Iesus captus esset. Matthia est unus ex auctoribus Evangeliorum, cuius Evangelium habet characterem distinctum, cum sit breve, concisum et perspicuum.

in_english.name: Matthia
in_english.meaning: Name Matthia, of Matthew, author of the Gospel of Matthew.
in_english.long_meaning: Matthia is a name of Hebrew origin, meaning 'gift of God'. Matthias was one of Jesus' disciples, who succeeded Judas, who betrayed Jesus. Matthia is one of the authors of the Gospels, whose Gospel has a distinct character, being brief, concise and perspicuous. The name Matthia has been used in Christian tradition to signify a gift from God, emphasizing the importance of faith and devotion in the Christian life.

data.spiritual_significance: Matthia, as a name, is deeply rooted in the spiritual tradition of Christianity. It serves as a reminder of the divine guidance and purpose that directs our lives.
